name: Material standard: România (SR ISO 128-50)
summary: How materials draw in cuts, plans and facades after SR ISO 128-50: Lapin's built-in „România (SR ISO 128-50)” standard as a pack (indicative).
description: The conventions of ISO 128-50 (SR ISO 128-50) with the materials named in Romanian and English: zidărie in 45° lines, BCA in 135° lines with dots, beton speckled, beton armat over 45° lines, polistiren crosshatched, vată minerală as loops, lemn grain, oțel filled solid from 1:50; facing brick 240 × 63. Indicative, drawn by Lapin from the general principles of the norm, not copied from it: check it against the standard your drawings must follow. Installed, it is added to the open project with „Add to this project” and applied from Manage → Drawing standards → Materials. Country: RO; norm: SR ISO 128-50.

items: 34 rules (cut, plan and facade graphics by the material's name)
